limits.uz:
• Iqlim katagi yirik. NASA POWER obi-havosi ~50 km (MERRA-2 0,5°×0,625°). Bitta katakdagi dalalar bitta tuman iqlim profiliga ega; tuproq, shoʻrlanish va sugʻorishni koʻrmaydi. Dala darajasidagi farqlar sunʼiy yoʻldosh qatlamlaridan (SMAP, ECOSTRESS, HLS) keladi.
  • Choʻl xatoligi → ET0 tuzatmasi. Reanaliz modelida sugʻorish yoʻq, shuning uchun vohalarda Tmax va ET0 yuqori. Ekin suv ehtiyoji (4–5-ekranlar) ET0 × 0,80 bilan hisoblanadi — MERRA-2 choʻl xatoligi uchun taxminiy, vaqtinchalik tuzatma (config/et0_correction.yaml da joy boʻyicha tahrirlanadi). AppEEARS orqali ECOSTRESS ET maʼlumotlari qoʻshilsa, koeffitsiyent ECOSTRESS bilan kalibrlanadi. 2-ekranda xom POWER ET0 koʻrsatiladi.
  • Faqat sof suv. m³/ga — ekinning sof ehtiyoji (FAO-56 ETc − samarali yogʻin). Dalaga beriladigan suv koʻproq: egat sugʻorishda FIK koʻpincha 50–60 %, shoʻr yuvish ham kerak.
  • Qoidalar, hosil emas. Moslik — issiqlik yigʻindisi, sovuq oynasi va issiq kunlar; hosil, narx yoki bozorni bashorat qilmaydi. Ekish sanasi — har bir ekinning odatiy ekish oynasi ichidagi eng yaxshi sana (masalan, paxta 1–20 aprel, kartoshka mart boshi yoki yozgi ekish); sovuq faqat unib chiqqandan yigʻimgacha hisoblanadi.
  • Yogʻin nazorati. POWER dagi bir nechta notoʻgʻri yogʻin choʻqqilari (> 80 mm/kun) olib tashlandi.
  • Ekinni oʻzgartirishdan oldin mahalliy agronom / suv isteʼmolchilari uyushmasi bilan maslahatlashing.
  • Almashlab ekish salomatligi — qoida bali, tuproq modeli emas. U qoidalar boʻyicha ball beradi (takrorlar, dukkakli tanaffus, oilalar xilma-xilligi); tuproq uglerodi, azot, shoʻrlanish yoki zararkunandalarni simulyatsiya qilmaydi.
  • Narx va hosil: imkon boricha FAOSTAT Oʻzbekiston (hosil 2022–24, narxlar 2023–24). Qovun, noʻxat va mosh narxlari — belgilangan proksi; beda hosili/narxi va barcha xarajatlar taxminiy. FAOSTAT pomidor narxi yillik oʻrtacha va ochiq dala narxidan yuqori boʻlishi mumkin — config/crops.csv ga qarang.
  • Suv ehtiyoji ET0 × joy tuzatma koeffitsiyenti bilan hisoblanadi (standart 0,80 — MERRA-2 choʻl xatoligi uchun taxminiy, vaqtinchalik tuzatma; ECOSTRESS maʼlumotlari qoʻshilsa — ECOSTRESS bilan kalibrlangan).
  • Kutilgan hosil = FAOSTAT milliy hosildorligi × iqlim xavfi koeffitsiyenti × almashlab ekish taʼsiri; bular taxminiy va tahrirlanadi.
  • Qovun rejalashtirilmaydi: navlari koʻp, tuproq/mavsum talablari turlicha va ishonchli narx yoʻq (keyingi ish).
  • Taxminiy (gipotetik) kiritmalar: suv byudjetlari, bozor cheklovi va demo xoʻjalik majburiyatlari — misollar, maʼlumot emas.
  • Ssenariylar oddiy: har kunga +1,5 °C (ET0, issiqlik, sovuq va SHY qayta hisoblangan); suv byudjeti −20 %. Narx yoki siyosat oʻzgarmaydi.
  • Paxtaga 2025 yilgi davlat subsidiyasi (1 000 soʻm/kg) qoʻshilgan; baribir uning foydasi past — bu paxta rentabelligi haqidagi haqiqiy bahsga mos. Pomidor, piyoz, kartoshka va makkajoʻxori hosili × 0,7 (ochiq dala, taxminiy).
  • Foyda gektarga hisoblangan; boshqa subsidiya, kredit, ishchi kuchi va narx xavfi hisobga olinmagan. U ±15 % taxminiy oraliq sifatida koʻrsatiladi; 3 000 USD/ga/yildan yuqori foyda "bu raqamni tekshiring" deb belgilanadi.
  • Maydon ulushi: xoʻjalik rejani 5 ta boʻlakda, har biri bir yil orqada yuritadi deb faraz qilinadi; k yil ekilgan ekin har yili maydonning k/5 qismini egallaydi. Pomidor, kartoshka, piyoz va qovun maydonning 25 % i bilan cheklangan (= 5 yilda 1 yil). Dukkaklilar (noʻxat, mosh, beda) narxi proksi boʻlgani uchun vaqtincha 40 % (= 5 yilda 2 yil) bilan cheklangan — haqiqiy mahalliy narxlar config/local_prices.csv ga kiritilguncha.
limits.en:
• Coarse climate grid. NASA POWER weather is ~50 km (MERRA-2 0.5°×0.625°). Fields in the same cell share one district climate profile; it cannot see your field's soil, salinity or irrigation. Field-level differences come from the satellite layers (SMAP, ECOSTRESS, HLS).
  • Desert bias → ET0 correction. The reanalysis model has no irrigation, so over irrigated oases its Tmax and ET0 are too high. Crop water needs (screens 4–5) therefore use ET0 × 0.80, an approximate, provisional bias correction for MERRA-2 desert bias over irrigated land (editable per site in config/et0_correction.yaml). When ECOSTRESS ET data are added via AppEEARS, the factor is calibrated with ECOSTRESS instead. Screen 2 shows the raw POWER ET0.
  • Net water only. m³/ha is the net crop need (FAO-56 ETc − effective rain). Real field delivery is higher: furrow irrigation efficiency is often 50–60 %, plus leaching for salinity.
  • Rules, not yields. Fit = heat sum, frost window and heat days with simple thresholds; it does not predict yield, price or market. The sowing date is the best date inside each crop's typical Uzbek sowing window (e.g. cotton 1–20 April, potato early March or a summer planting); frost counts only between emergence and harvest.
  • Rain QC. A few spurious POWER rain spikes (> 80 mm/day) were removed.
  • Talk to your local agronomist / water user association before changing crops.
  • Rotation health is a rule score, not a soil model. It counts rule-based points (repeats, legume breaks, plant-family diversity); it does not simulate soil carbon, nitrogen, salinity or pests.
  • Prices and yields: FAOSTAT Uzbekistan where available (yields 2022–24, producer prices 2023–24). Melon, chickpea and mung bean prices use labelled proxies; alfalfa yield/price and all costs per ha are approximate placeholders. The FAOSTAT tomato price is an annual average and probably overstates open-field farm-gate prices — see config/crops.csv.
  • Water need uses ET0 × the site's correction factor (default 0.80, approximate, provisional bias correction for MERRA-2 desert bias over irrigated land; calibrated with ECOSTRESS when those data are added).
  • Expected yield = FAOSTAT national yield × climate-risk factor × rotation effect; these factors are approximate and editable (config/planner.yaml, config/rotation_rules.yaml).
  • Melon is not planned: many varieties with different soil/season needs and no reliable farm-gate price (future work).
  • Hypothetical inputs: water budgets, the fresh-market limit and demo-farm obligations are examples, not data.
  • Scenarios are simple: +1.5 °C added to every day (ET0, heat, frost and GDD recomputed); −20 % water budget. No price or policy changes.
  • Cotton includes the 2025 state subsidy (1,000 so'm/kg); its margin stays low, which matches the real debate about cotton profitability. Tomato, onion, potato and maize yields are × 0.7 (open-field realism, approximate).
  • Profit is per hectare and ignores other subsidies, credit, labour limits and price risk. It is shown as a ±15 % estimate range; any crop margin above 3,000 USD/ha/year is flagged "check this number".
  • Area share: the farm is assumed to run the plan on 5 blocks, each one year behind the next, so a crop grown in k of 5 years covers k/5 of the farm each year. Tomato, potato, onion and melon are limited to 25 % of the area (= 1 year in 5). Legumes (chickpea, mung bean, alfalfa) are provisionally limited to 40 % (= 2 years in 5) because their prices are proxies, until real local prices are added in config/local_prices.csv. Editable in config/crops.csv.

smap_note.uz: NASA SMAP L4 (SPL4SMGP) ildiz qatlami tuproq namligi, 9 km, har 3 soatda, AppEEARS orqali. Bu model + sunʼiy yoʻldosh mahsuloti va sugʻorishni hisobga olmaydi: sugʻoriladigan dalada u kanal suvisiz yer qanchalik qurishini koʻrsatadi. DalaShift uni maʼlumot va tekshiruv uchun ishlatadi; ekin tavsiyalarini oʻzgartirmaydi.
smap_note.en: NASA SMAP L4 (SPL4SMGP) root-zone soil moisture, 9 km, 3-hourly, via AppEEARS. It is a model + satellite product that does NOT simulate irrigation, so over irrigated fields it shows how dry the land is without canal water (how much the field depends on irrigation). DalaShift uses it as information and validation; it does not change the crop recommendations.

hls_note.uz: HLS NDVI (Landsat HLSL30_VI + Sentinel-2 HLSS30_VI, 30 m, Fmask bilan bulutlar olib tashlangan), kunlik birlashtirilgan, haftalik, 3 haftalik median. Qarshi: 2025 aprelda (kuzgi bugʻdoy) va 2026 avgustda (yozgi ekin) choʻqqi — odatiy bugʻdoy ↔ paxta almashlab ekish, DalaShift ekin kalendarlariga mos. Tavsiyalarni oʻzgartirish uchun emas, tekshiruv uchun ishlatiladi.
hls_note.en: HLS NDVI (Landsat HLSL30_VI + Sentinel-2 HLSS30_VI, 30 m, cloud-masked with Fmask), merged per day, weekly, 3-week median. Karshi: peaks in April 2025 (winter wheat) and August 2026 (summer crop), the usual wheat ↔ cotton rotation, matching DalaShift's crop calendars. Used as a sanity check, not to change recommendations.

ecostress_note.uz: ECOSTRESS (ECO_L4T_ESI ESI, ECO_L3T_JET ETdaily, 70 m): 2025 yil iyun–sentyabrda Qarshi dalasi uchun faqat 2 ta bulutsiz tasvir bor (8 iyun: ET 2,4 mm/kun, ESI 0,45 — bugʻdoy pishmoqda; 25 sentyabr: ET 2,4 mm/kun, ESI 0,63). ET0 ni kalibrlash uchun kamida 5 ta iyun–avgust kuni kerak, shuning uchun vaqtinchalik ×0,80 tuzatma qoldirildi.
ecostress_note.en: ECOSTRESS (ECO_L4T_ESI ESI, ECO_L3T_JET ETdaily, 70 m): only 2 cloud-free scenes reached the Karshi field in Jun–Sep 2025 (8 Jun: ET 2.4 mm/day, ESI 0.45, wheat ripening; 25 Sep: ET 2.4 mm/day, ESI 0.63). The ET0 calibration needs at least 5 June–August days, so the provisional ×0.80 correction is kept.

usual_short.uz: Bu odatiy reja sizning suvingizga sigʻmaydi: paxta yilida 6,9 ming tonna (m³) suv yetmaydi.
usual_short.en: This usual rotation does not fit your water: 6.9 thousand tonnes (m³) short in cotton years.

risk_reason.en: many very hot days while Chickpea flowers

why.uz: Noʻxat tuproqqa azot beradi, shuning uchun undan keyingi ekin yaxshiroq hosil beradi. Kuzgi bugʻdoy qishda oʻsadi va kam suv ichadi. Ekinlar har yili almashadi — zararkunanda va kasalliklar kamroq toʻplanadi. Eng koʻp suv talab qiladigan yilda ham suvingizning katta qismi ishlatiladi. Odatiy almashlab ekishingizga nisbatan daromad 46 % koʻproq, suv 48 % kamroq. Paxta bu yerda gektariga taxminan 13 ming tonna suv talab qiladi — bu sizdagidan koʻp, shuning uchun u rejada yoʻq.
why.en: Chickpea feeds the soil with nitrogen, so the crop after it yields better. Winter wheat grows over winter and needs little water. The crop changes every year, so pests and diseases build up less. Even the thirstiest year uses most of your water. Compared with your usual rotation, income is 46 % higher and water use is 48 % lower. Cotton needs about 13 thousand tonnes of water per hectare here, more than you have, so it is not in the plan.
